title: An aggregate score can conceal a weak task slice
method: Synthetic two-group evaluation with 100 transactions per group. Overall accuracy is (95 + 70)/200 = 82.5%. Groups are illustrative task segments; no demographic claim or causal explanation is implied.
alt: An aggregate score can conceal a weak task slice. Group A: 95 correct predictions out of 100, Group B: 70 correct predictions out of 100. Illustrative data.
